name: financial_calculator
description: Local financial calculation tool covering six modes. Input: calculator_type (string, required) — one of: compound_interest, loan_repayment, roi, present_value, future_value, break_even. Conditional numeric inputs by mode — compound_interest: principal, rate (annual %), periods (years). loan_repayment: principal (loan amount), rate (annual %), periods (months). roi: initial_value, final_value, optional periods (years). present_value: future_amount, discount_rate (%), periods (years). future_value: principal, rate (%), periods (years). break_even: fixed_costs, variable_cost_per_unit, price_per_unit. Output: calculator_type (string), result values (numbers), formula (string), full breakdown object. Pure local computation, no external API call.

calculator_type.description: The type of financial calculation to perform. One of: compound_interest, loan_repayment, roi, present_value, future_value, break_even.

principal.description: Starting amount or loan amount in your chosen currency. Used for compound_interest, loan_repayment, and future_value calculations.

rate.description: Annual interest or discount rate expressed as a percentage. Example: 5 for 5% per year.

periods.description: Number of time periods. For compound_interest and future_value: years. For loan_repayment: months.

initial_value.description: Starting value of an investment or asset. Used for roi calculations.

final_value.description: Ending value of an investment or asset. Used for roi and present_value calculations.

discount_rate.description: Annual discount rate as a percentage for present value calculations.

future_amount.description: The target future cash amount to discount back to present value.

fixed_costs.description: Total fixed costs that do not vary with output volume. Used for break_even.

variable_cost_per_unit.description: Variable cost incurred per unit produced or sold. Used for break_even.

price_per_unit.description: Selling price per unit of product or service. Used for break_even.
